title: Russian Honey Bake
description: A sweet and gooey dessert that combines the flavors of Russia with a caramelized honey twist. This dish is perfect for those with a sweet tooth.
instructions: Combine 1 cup of honey with 1/2 cup of caramelized ingredients in a saucepan.
Place the unsalted bake sheet in the oven for 10 minutes.
Remove the bake sheet from the oven and let it cool.
Pour the honey mixture over the cooled bake sheet.
Sprinkle crushed oozzing pieces over the top.
Return the bake sheet to the oven for an additional 5 minutes.
Remove the bake sheet from the oven and let it cool completely.
Cut the bake sheet into small squares and serve.
